summary_md:
**Tom Dörr ([@tom_doerr](https://x.com/tom_doerr/status/2115405924646985924))** shares **ffmpeg-skill**, which gives Claude Code, Cursor and other MCP clients 42 local FFmpeg video-editing tools via `npx ffmpeg-skill`.

The README screenshot describes it as giving your coding agent a video editor: a fixed probe → edit losslessly → check → verify workflow, tools for cuts, captions/karaoke, reframing to 9:16, silence removal, loudness, HDR→SDR/LUTs and more, also exposed as an MCP server; no cloud and no API keys.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill: Local video editor for coding agents: 42 FFmpeg tools with a machine-readable contract and an MCP server, for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Cut, captions, reframe, loudness, platform exports. No cloud, no API keys.

relevance: A broadly adopted, local-only toolkit that turns any coding agent into a verifiable video editor.

ffmpeg-skill
Give your coding agent a video editor.
Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client edits your footage with local FFmpeg, then checks its own output.
No cloud · No API keys · Python standard library
npx ffmpeg-skill
caption.py --animate pop --karaoke · fit.py --aspect 9:16 --fit crop · silence.py --threshold -35 · loudness.py -I -14 --tp -1
ffmpeg-skill is an Agent Skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and any agent that reads SKILL.md. It teaches the agent a fixed workflow (probe → edit losslessly where possible → check → verify) and ships 42 tools that do the actual work with ffmpeg / ffprobe
